# IEEE Spectrum

> > IEEE Spectrum is the flagship publication of the IEEE, covering cutting-edge developments in technology, engineering, and science with expert analysis and reporting.

IEEE Spectrum provides in-depth coverage of robotics, autonomous vehicles, climate technology, and emerging engineering innovations. The publication features regular video roundups, investigative reporting, and expert commentary from leading researchers and industry professionals.

## Key Topics

- Robotics and Automation
- Autonomous Vehicles
- Tesla Autopilot and Full Self-Driving
- Drone Technology
- 3D Printing
- Biped and Humanoid Robots
- Crash Avoidance Systems
- Active Safety Systems
- Climate Change and Decarbonization
- Urban Agriculture Technology
- Display Technologies
- SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping)
- EV Safety
- Driver Assistance Systems

## Autonomous Vehicles & Transportation Safety

- [Billionaire Brings Tesla Autopilot Rebuke](https://spectrum.ieee.org/tesla-full-self-driving-critic): Critical analysis of Tesla's Full Self-Driving mode safety concerns
- [The Crash-Proof Car](https://spectrum.ieee.org/the-crashproof-car): Feature on active safety systems and collision prevention technology

## Robotics & Video Friday

- [Video Friday: Drone Dogfight, 3D-Printed Arm, and Kicking a Robot](https://spectrum.ieee.org/video-friday-drones-3d-printed-arm-atrias-biped): Weekly robotics video roundup featuring ATRIAS biped and drone tech
- [Video Friday: Marvin Minsky, Submersible Drone, and SLAM on a SnakeBot](https://spectrum.ieee.org/video-friday-marvin-minsky-submersible-drone-slam-snakebot): Weekly robotics video collection featuring Marvin Minsky tribute

## Climate & Sustainability Technology

- [Engineers: You Can Disrupt Climate Change](https://spectrum.ieee.org/engineers-you-can-disrupt-climate-change): Opinion piece on decarbonization and climate tech opportunities
- [MIT's Food Computer: The Future of Urban Agriculture?](https://spectrum.ieee.org/mits-food-computer-the-future-of-urban-agriculture): MIT Media Lab's open-source Food Computer for controlled agriculture

## Emerging Technologies

- [A Bright New Page in Portable Displays](https://spectrum.ieee.org/a-bright-new-page-in-portable-displays): Overview of emerging portable display technologies and e-paper
